instruction.text: Is it an infinitive or a prepositional phrase?

hint.text:
An infinitive is a verbal made up of to and a verb.
A prepositional phrase is made up of to and a noun, pronoun or any modifiers.
hint.sound:
An infinitive is a verbal made up of to, and a verb.
A prepositional phrase is made up of to, and a noun, pronoun or any modifiers.

hint.text: An infinitive is a verbal made up of the word to and the simple form of a verb.

atoms.b: Digestion is different for everyone. After ingesting food, it can take 6-8 hours for it ((to_pass)) through your stomach and small intestine. ((To_break_down)) the food, stomach acid in your stomach plays an important role. After a short stay in your stomach and small intestine, food then enters your large intestine for further digestion and absorption of water. After about a day and a half to two days, your body then needs ((to_remove)) whatever is left over for good.

instruction.text: Fill in the correct infinitive form of the verb in the sentences below.

atoms.finishSound: Jacinda likes to write song lyrics.

atoms.b: ((To_interrupt)) (interrupt) someone while they are talking is rude.
atoms.finishSound: To interrupt someone while they are talking is rude.

atoms.b: Joshua’s goal in life is ((to_achieve)) (achieve) peace and happiness.
atoms.finishSound: Joshua’s goal in life is to achieve peace and happiness.

atoms.b: Colin wants ((to_eat)) (eat) that stack of pancakes.
atoms.finishSound: Colin wants to eat that stack of pancakes.
